text:
Mike: Planning to deploy web-api v2.3.0 to prod at 2024-07-21 18:10 UTC (was 18:00, bumped 10m). Need a deploy lead, rollback lead, smoke monitor, and on-call overlap. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.runbooks/web-api-deploy-v2.3
Ana: Ack — deploy lead. I'll own smoke checklist and post results here.
Jordan: Ack — rollback lead. Read the runbook. Rollback criteria I care about: sustained error rate >5% over 5m or p50 latency >1s for 5m. Quick undo available: `./ops/undo_deploy.sh web-api 2.3.0` (also documented in runbook).
Taylor: Quick q — any DB schema migrations or writes that need special handling? Also will this be feature-flag gated?
Mike: No DB schema changes. We will gate behind feature flag `ff/webapi_v2`. Flow: deploy -> canary 10% -> run smoke -> toggle flag -> ramp. If flag toggle breaks, revert flag first then consider rollback.
Ana: My smoke checklist (will run at T+5m after deploy): health check, auth/login, search, product endpoints, synthetic smoke traffic, sampling traces. I'll post pass/fail per item.
Jordan: I'll monitor rollback triggers + be reachable. Phone on for call: +1-415-555-0112. If I see trigger, I'll call and post decision here.
ops-bot: Reminder — Quiet window in effect. Deployment scheduled for 2024-07-21T18:10Z. Channel: #eng-releases.
Mike: Minor timing update posted — start at 18:10 UTC due to canary backlog. Ana, confirm you can start then?
Ana: Confirmed 18:10. I'll kick off smoke at T+5 and report around T+15.
Taylor: Canary plan: 10% traffic for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then 100% if stable. I'll keep slow ramp if any anomaly.
Jordan: Add to rollback criteria: canary error rate >3% for 3 consecutive minutes -> immediate rollback. Make that canary threshold explicit in runbook.
Ana: Acknowledged; I'll watch canary error rate and 1m/5m p95 latency.
Mike: Who's monitoring infra metrics (kafka lag, redis, DB connections) during deploy?
Taylor: I can glance infra dashboards; will alert if anything unusual.
Ana: I'll run traffic checks and look at traces.
Mike: Are folks available for 2h post-deploy for follow-ups?
Taylor: Available 3h.
Jordan: Available 2h.
Ana: Available 2h.
Mike: OK — proceeding as planned. Ping here when you see smoke pass/fail. :thumbsup:
